title: Zeta Zeros and Signed Liouville Energies
description: A multipole theorem bounds the normalized Liouville energy from below by a sum of pole contributions. A positive Fejer weight and a certified finite calculation give an unconditional limsup lower bound strictly greater than 1811/2500. RH and Dirichlet GRH remain open.
